about: Run 20 round 1 fix (a): the seller descriptions read by detectVertical and detectModel. Plain words, no real company names. Rows with an owner number are the owner's ten cases (owner 1 to 10), word for word; their expected values never change. model null means the owner gave no model for that row, so only the sector is checked. Every other row is a row of the helper's own (35) or an extra hard case (extra). Figures in the descriptions are hypothetical.
